content.text:
I couldn't save the migration file. A hook from the `team-workflow` plugin blocks writes to `migrations/` because those paths need human review. I didn't try to get around it, so you'll need to create the file yourself. Nothing was run against the database.

The file to create is `migrations/0001_add_users_last_login_at.sql`. It's numbered 0001 because no `migrations/` directory exists yet.

```sql
-- Add last_login_at to users. Nullable: existing users have no recorded login.
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- Rollback:
-- ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN last_login_at;
```

The column is nullable because the current users (Ada, Grace and Alan in `src/db.js`) have no login on record.

`src/db.js` is an in-memory store, not a real SQL database, so this SQL won't change it. If the app should see the new field, `last_login_at: null` also has to be added to each seeded user row in that file.
